name: @agntux/teams-mcp-server
description: Minimal local stdio MCP server for the agntux-teams plugin. Registers ZERO tools — per the P3 v2 no-escalation-no-tools policy, all team-coordination work runs in the /agntux-teams skill body, not in MCP tools.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --target=node18 --sourcemap --allow-overwrite --banner:js='import { createRequire as _esmCreateRequire } from "module"; const require = _esmCreateRequire(import.meta.url);'
